name: geosweep
description: IoT-powered municipal solid-waste collection and fleet tracking platform

scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n "BACKEND,WEB,MOBILE" -c "blue,green,magenta" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:mobile"
scripts.build: npm --prefix geosweep-backend run build && npm --prefix geosweep-web run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix geosweep-backend run typecheck && npm --prefix geosweep-web run typecheck && npm --prefix geosweep-mobile run typecheck
